depends_on.name: cells_document_id
depends_on.documentation: The cells document these labels are aligned to. Row order must match.

depends_on.name: reference_document_id
depends_on.documentation: Optional back-pointer to the source atlas / taxonomy / clustering result the labels came from.

file.name: labels.tsv
file.documentation: One row per cell, aligned to the cells document's row order.

fields.name: label
fields.documentation: A human-readable label for this labeling (e.g. 'G&T 2026 subclass, NN transfer').

fields.name: label_name
fields.documentation: The name of the labeled variable as it appeared in the source (e.g. 'subclass_nn_column', 'leiden').

fields.name: taxonomy_level
fields.documentation: Where this sits in a class/subclass/type hierarchy, if any. Free text; use '' for flat or unsupervised labelings.

fields.name: n_cells
fields.documentation: The number of data rows in labels.tsv. Must equal the n_cells of the cells document.

fields.name: n_categories
fields.documentation: The number of distinct non-empty categories.

fields.name: n_unlabeled
fields.documentation: How many cells have no category.

fields.name: assignment_method
fields.documentation: How labels were assigned (e.g. 'nearest-neighbor transfer from a dissociated atlas', 'Leiden clustering', 'manual').

fields.name: is_unsupervised
fields.documentation: 1 if the labels come from unsupervised clustering and therefore carry no biological identity. Leiden and SNN clusterings must set this to 1 so they are not mistaken for cell type calls.
